notes.title: 💠⚓Seven Wonders Chapter 3.5 BABYLON is here! ✨💠
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33820238/07b278e9950c67982a997ec20f1c2e3c458385f2.jpg[/img]

Ahoy Captains!

[b]💠⚓Seven Wonders Chapter 3.5 BABYLON is here! ✨💠[/b]
The BABYLON update is now LIVE and here are the details of the update:

[list]
[*] Two new Ships: New Ships have been added, including the strongest buildable battleship ever, the Melville.
[*] Cannon Revamp: Some of the previously introduced craftable cannons have also improved their performance.
[*] New Legacy Theme: Seek for clues around the world to decode the mystery of an ancient land.
[*] Advanced Missions in the Coliseum: Now advanced missions with more powerful NPCs and special prizes are available.
[*] New cities: Yambu, Visakhapatnam, and Manama were added in for more cities to explore.
[*] New Discovery Quests and Discoveries: Continue forth with new Discovery Quests and make new discoveries.
[*] More Sophia Awakening Recipes: More items are now targets of the Sophia Awakening Transmutation. Use Sophia to produce extraordinary items.
[*] Epic Pirate Feud Update: The battle now lasts for 2 hours and features new rewards, changes to attacking Lead Ships, and the effects of Equipment. 
[/list]

https://bit.ly/Ch3-7Babylon_u

See you all on the high seas!
-Team Uncharted Waters

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33820238/9372dac3c770a1e332e51651da93a72328b2b24a.png[/img]

Ahoy Captains!

[Lost Memories Ch 1.5 has arrived!]
Besides new contents, enjoy playing with 3 accounts at once for a smoother and more fulfilling gameplay!
https://uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=2505

[b][i]In order to open and play with 3 game clients of UWO, please follow the steps below:[/i][/b]
1. Log into your STEAM account and open the Uncharted Waters Online game client.
2. While keeping the UWO game client open, force close STEAM by selecting the STEAM application icon in the Notification Area on the Taskbar and clicking “Exit”.
3. Start up your STEAM and log into your account. Repeat the above steps until you have 3 UWO game clients open.
